prompt.composition: UTF-8 original Task.Instruction (upstream trim) + two LF + exact appendix file bytes; appendix is not trimmed

private_verifier.distribution: controller-only; inject into the original Sandbox only after confirmed stop and bridge revocation

environment_preparation.binding: reuse the selected original task binding; freeze any declared initial-directory mtime adaptation before the first new recording
environment_preparation.native_image: must freeze a verified image containing terminal-result-v1; no digest invented in this material
environment_preparation.runtime_created_metadata: remain real; do not rewrite runtime timestamps or tool output
environment_preparation.sqlite_toolchain: inherit declared general toolchain adaptation; never prebuild the task answer

acceptance: new real autonomous Agent recording passes the original independent verifier
new Tape complete; same full request/history Strict matching; real tools execute again
at least two new-Sandbox replays plus same-Tape Huawei/E2B comparison after independent preparation
preserve all failed, canceled and unstarted attempts; no post-hoc Tape or matcher edits
same CPU/memory, variant, Tape and placement; report disk/platform differences without disqualifying solely for those differences
confirm stop/revocation, private verification and owned Sandbox cleanup; keep missing timing absent
limits: not an unchanged official benchmark submission
a stable logical handle is not a real PID; child output can still be dynamic
native poll/log/PTY remain available and may produce non-repeatable live results
raw job evidence is not automatically an analyzed Trace or complete process-call coverage
preparation, runtime, model wait, tool work and independent verification have distinct measured boundaries
